bio: Dr. Elizabeth Linos is the Emma Bloomberg Professor of Public Policy and Management, and Faculty Director of The People Lab at the Harvard Kennedy School of Government. The majority of her research focuses on how to improve government by focusing on its people and the services they deliver.
